resources.string:
Management accounting helps you decide what to change. Use pricing, stock losses and staffing data to explain changes in sales or margin.

Financial accounting records the result. P&L shows income and expenses, Balance Sheet shows what the café owns and owes, and Cash Flow shows money received and paid.

Try ordering stock with deferred payment. It increases inventory and supplier debt in the balance sheet. Paying the invoice reduces bank and debt, and appears in Cash Flow. Ingredients used in a sale become a cost in P&L. Tap an account row marked › to follow it into the journal and open the debit and credit lines.
Both months through the same day and time (%1$s).
